title: Plux canvas document
description: Editor-only layout of the Studio canvas: where plugin boxes, native routes and frames sit in an app, or where screens and the screens and routes they link to sit in a plugin (STU-032, STU-035, STU-050, STU-052). It is versioned and snapshotted like any document and is never compiled into a bundle. File: `canvas.json` (app) or `plugins/<key>/canvas.json` (plugin).

positions.description: The top-left corner of each box: a plugin in an app canvas; a screen (page) in a plugin canvas, its own or another plugin's it links to. The number of entries, with routes, is bounded by the limit canvas.positions.

id.description: The id of the plugin or page the box shows.

routes.description: The top-left corner of each box of a native route the canvas's plugins or screens navigate to (STU-033, STU-054), by route name: a native route has no document id. The number of entries, with positions, is bounded by the limit canvas.positions.

route.description: The native route the box shows.

frames.description: Labelled groups of plugins (STU-035), for example "Onboarding" or "Payments". Only app canvases carry frames. The number of entries is bounded by the limit canvas.frames.

members.description: The ids of the plugins in the frame. The number of entries is bounded by the limit canvas.frameMembers.

worldUnit.description: A coordinate in canvas world units.
